messages:
incidents-bot: Pager (P1) triggered: inference latency spike in us-west2 affecting /v1/generate — elevated 5xxs for 3 customers. Paging @oncall-group. Please ack and triage.
maya: Acked. I'm oncall — looking at dashboards now. Any recent deploys?
jeremy: no deploys in last 30m. CPU on infer01 spiked, KV cache evict rate jumped ~3x.
maya: seeing same, tail logs show repeated cache misses + retries to fallback model. Starting quick inventory of nodes.
olivia: if KV thrash, consider rerouting a portion of traffic to quantized fallback to keep latency SLO. Can we do a 10% canary first?
maya: doing a 10% canary reroute to redwood-medium-quant now.
maya: ```/route update --policy latency --fraction 0.10 --fallback redwood-medium-quant```
incidents-bot: Pager acknowledged by maya. Incident start 2260456789.
jeremy: after canary: p50/p95 improved on canary hosts, overall errors dropping. Looks like hot key + cache churn.
maya: good, moving to 50% canary while we investigate hot key source.
raj: heads up — affected customers include two enterprise customers; product wants a postmortem and mitigation plan linked to the Q2 reliability sprint.
maya: latency stabilized after 50% reroute; error rate down to baseline. Preparing handoff to post-incident.
olivia: handoff plan: 1) schedule postmortem within 48h 2) create action items, owners, sizes 3) add to remediation backlog and tag Q2 reliability epic.
maya: I'll open the postmortem draft and capture timeline + metrics. tagging jeremy for KV cache root cause.
jeremy: I'll own KV cache tuning and hot-key mitigation. ETA for initial fixes: 3 days (investigation + deploy). Size estimate: 5 (medium).
maya: I'll own rollback guard and traffic-routing playbook updates. Estimate: 2 days (size 3).
olivia: I'll own the postmortem doc and coordination with product for customer comms. Will create meeting invite for 48h from now.
raj: Prioritization: because this was a customer-impacting P1 with revenue risk, action items -> Severity=High -> include in next sprint planning, tie to Q2 reliability epic. Suggested ordering: 1) hot-key mitigation (P0) 2) autoscaler thresholds review (P1) 3) routing playbook (P1).
maya: quick notes on autoscaler: saw several restarts when memory rose -> suggest increasing headroom and adding cache warmup probes. I'll add suggested thresholds to the postmortem.
jeremy: created ticket INC-4521 for KV cache tuning and linked to postmortem (https://issue.tracker/INC-4521). assigning to me + labeling: sev=high, sprint=q2-reliability.
incidents-bot: Incident noted as mitigated at 2260456890. Postmortem scheduled meeting created for 48h. Reminder: include measurable signal thresholds and rollback steps in action items.
maya: thanks everyone. I'll paste postmortem link in this thread once initial draft is ready. :thumbsup:
olivia: great work — capture followups in the postmortem and add estimated effort fields so PM can prioritize into the quarterly plan.
raj: will coordinate with PM to ensure these items get scoping in the Q2 plan. :white_check_mark:
